# Naming, Device Linking & Setup Tidy-up

Holds now name themselves, a single-sensor hold can live on its sensor's own device, and the setup screens are easier to read.

### New
- **Automatic names.** Leave **Name** blank and the hold is named after its sensor or area, e.g. **Ensuite Hold**, or **Ensuite Latch** with a door latch. You can still type your own, and rename it later.
- **Show on the sensor's device.** For a single-sensor hold, tick this to add the hold's entities to the motion sensor's own device instead of creating a new one. They're named **Hold**, **Hold clears at** and **Hold time**, so they don't clash with the sensor's entities.

### Changed
- **First screen** no longer cuts off. The choices are now **One sensor** and **A whole room**, each with a short description underneath.
- **Clearer intro text** explaining what a hold does.
- "VALLHORN-style" is now **IKEA VALLHORN style**.

### Upgrade notes
- Existing holds keep their names, devices and entities.
- Requires Home Assistant 2025.3 or later. Automated tests run on Home Assistant 2026.2.
- Update from **Settings → Updates**, then restart Home Assistant.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sambarlick/Hold-Latch/compare/v0.2.0...v0.3.0
